reason: The README identifies sai as an Android coding agent that orchestrates model-driven coding sessions with local files, terminals, Git, browser capabilities, approvals, and external service integrations.

summaries.zh: sai 是一款面向 Android 的本地优先编码智能体，可在工作区中协调模型会话、文件与终端操作、Git 及浏览器工具，并通过审批执行任务。
summaries.en: sai is a local-first Android coding agent that coordinates model sessions with workspace files, terminal operations, Git, browser tools, and approval-based task execution.

capabilities: runs coding-agent workflows in a local Android workspace
executes shell commands through a PRoot-compatible runtime
uses model APIs and GitHub integrations
supports browser operations and MCP or skill extensions
stores provider credentials and GitHub credentials in Android-managed encrypted storage
